question.question: Use the January 2022 public announcement and the implementation instructions recorded in the Minutes to distinguish ending net asset purchases from stopping reinvestment of principal. What end date was announced for net purchases, and what rollover/reinvestment instructions were still in force?
question.answer: Net purchases were scheduled to end in early March. The current instructions still rolled over all Treasury principal at auction and reinvested all agency debt/MBS principal in agency MBS. Ending net additions did not itself mean immediately redeeming all maturing securities without replacement.

facets.name: net_purchase_end
needles: bringing them to an end in early March

facets.name: principal_instructions
needles: Roll over at auction all principal payments
